question: Which of the following state governments announced in March 2022 to confer the Sushma Swaraj Award on women for their contribution to different walks of life?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Haryana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Haryana state government announced the **Sushma Swaraj Award** in March 2022 to honor women for their contributions across various fields.
 
• The award was named after **Sushma Swaraj**, a renowned Indian politician and former Minister of External Affairs who hailed from Haryana.
 
• It aims to recognize the achievements and contributions of women in diverse areas such as social work, education, art, culture, and politics.
 
• The Haryana government has actively promoted women-centric policies to empower and uplift women across the state.
 
• This initiative aligns with Haryana's broader focus on gender equality and women empowerment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sushma Swaraj:**

 
 
• She was a senior leader of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and served as India's Minister of External Affairs from 2014 to 2019.
 
• Swaraj was known for her strong leadership and dedication to public service, earning respect across party lines.
 
• She was the first woman Chief Minister of Delhi and a prominent advocate for women's empowerment.
 
 
 
• **Haryana’s Women Empowerment Initiatives:**
 
 
• Haryana is known for schemes like **Beti Bachao Beti Padhao**, which aims to improve the status of women in the state.
 
• The state government also provides financial incentives for the education of girls and supports women entrepreneurs through various programs.
 
 
 
• **Awards for Women in India:**
 
 
• Other notable awards for women include the **Nari Shakti Puraskar**, given annually by the Indian government to recognize exceptional women and organizations.
 
• These awards aim to celebrate women achievers and encourage gender equality across diverse fields.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Women-Centric Awards:**
 
 
• Such awards play a crucial role in motivating women to excel in their respective fields and contribute to societal progress.
 
• They highlight the importance of gender inclusion in fostering sustainable development.
